This is your chance to be part of the another Community, an innovative and multicultural team that’s redefining the rules of communication. If you're passionate about strategy, creativity, and results, this is the place for you. WE ARE HIRING: Influencer Marketing Manager (HUB / UGC & Performance) Requirements 5+ years of experience in Influencer Marketing, Creator Marketing, Digital Marketing, Growth, or Performance, preferably within digital agencies, influencer marketing agencies, talent agencies, or consumer/beauty brands. Proven experience managing large-scale Influencer Marketing budgets, ideally exceeding $8M MXN annually. Strong experience in budget allocation, monitoring, optimization, and reallocation based on campaign performance and business objectives. Deep knowledge of the influencer, creator, talent management, and agency ecosystem in Mexico, particularly within Beauty and Lifestyle. Experience developing and implementing UGC programs, including creator sourcing, contracting, usage rights, content production, and amplification. Experience with experiential marketing, connecting offline activations with creator content, digital amplification, and campaign measurement. Strong understanding of Paid Media and Performance Marketing, particularly Meta Ads and TikTok Ads, including creator content amplification. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect investment, creators, content, paid media, and business results. Experience analyzing campaign performance through metrics such as CPM, CPE, CPV, CTR, CPA, conversions, ROAS, and ROI. Advanced English (mandatory). Activities Develop and lead Influencer Marketing and UGC strategies aligned with brand and business objectives. Manage and optimize large-scale Influencer Marketing budgets, ensuring efficient allocation across creators, UGC, experiential activations, and Paid Media. Monitor campaign performance and dynamically reallocate investment based on results, creator performance, platforms, formats, and business priorities. Lead the scouting, selection, negotiation, and management of influencers, creators, celebrities, KOLs, talent managers, and agencies. Develop and oversee UGC programs, including creator volume, contracting models, usage rights, production processes, and content delivery. Coordinate experiential marketing activations and connect offline experiences with creator content, amplification, and measurement. Work closely with Paid Media teams to amplify influencer and creator content through Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Partnership Ads, Spark Ads, and other paid formats. Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to increase, maintain, reallocate, or stop investment based on data. Maintain direct client communication, including strategic presentations, budget reviews, campaign performance, optimization recommendations, and timelines. Lead and coordinate internal teams and external partners to ensure campaign quality, profitability, and results. distro-distro:lever:479029c8-4f5b-4ea2-a.description: Facilities Manager - Bedford, MA Compensation: Target salary range: $100,000 - $131,000 base salary. Quantum Computing Inc. is seeking a hands-on Facilities Manager to support laboratory, cleanroom, technical manufacturing, and critical infrastructure operations. This role requires a combination of facilities leadership and strong technical facilities experience. The ideal candidate should be capable of managing vendors, contractors, preventive maintenance programs, and facility projects while also maintaining a deep understanding of building systems, utilities, and maintenance operations. Target experience includes: • Cleanrooms (ISO, GMP, semiconductor, photonics, biotech, or advanced manufacturing) • Research laboratories or technical facilities • HVAC, chillers, boilers, air handlers, exhaust systems, and building automation systems (BAS/BMS) • Compressed gas systems (nitrogen, argon, specialty gases, etc.) • Preventive maintenance program ownership and development • CMMS administration and maintenance planning • SOP/MOP development and implementation • Facility reliability and troubleshooting • Critical utility systems • Vendor and contractor management • Capital projects and facility improvements • Environmental Health & Safety compliance Preferred industries: • Semiconductor • Photonics • Optics • Advanced Manufacturing • Biotechnology • Pharmaceutical Manufacturing • Defense / Aerospace Laboratories • Research Institutions • Government Technical Facilities Strong preference for candidates with recent hands-on facilities experience supporting technical environments. Target Titles: Facilities Manager Facilities Engineer Senior Facilities Engineer Facilities Operations Manager Technical Facilities Manager Facilities Maintenance Manager Building Engineer #HireFinder #LI-PROMOTED #LI-Onsite

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:d3531299-1b9.title: Operations Supervisor
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:d3531299-1b9.description: Team Success Supervisor Are you driven by the opportunity to inspire teams and deliver exceptional client experiences? Wing Assistant is seeking a Hybrid Team Success Supervisor to elevate our Virtual Assistant's performance and ensure top-notch service across industries! About the Role: As our Team Success Supervisor, you’ll play a vital role in leading, coaching, and managing our Virtual Assistant team. In this position, you will focus on guiding team members to reach their fullest potential while fostering a collaborative, client-centric environment.
responsibilities: Manage a team of Virtual Assistants, fostering a positive, productive, and engaging work culture. You’ll ensure each team member understands their goals and has the resources they need to succeed.
Offer tailored coaching to VAs based on their experience and industry needs. Regularly meet with each VA to discuss performance, set objectives, and provide actionable feedback for growth.
Attend 2-3 in-person collaborative sessions per week with the core team to strategize, discuss team progress, and plan initiatives that promote continuous improvement in service delivery.
Leverage your knowledge of various industries to support VAs in delivering industry-specific solutions, addressing diverse client needs, and adapting to new sectors as required.
Set measurable performance goals, track team progress, and identify areas for improvement. Conduct regular performance evaluations and ensure high standards are consistently met.
Act as the first point of contact for escalated issues, working to resolve client concerns, mitigate risks, and implement solutions to improve overall team efficiency.
Encourage VAs to share insights and identify areas for personal and professional development. Develop initiatives that inspire ongoing learning and growth within the team.
qualifications: Minimum of 3-5 years in a supervisory role with a strong background in managing and coaching teams.
Proven ability to guide and motivate team members, helping them achieve their goals and grow in their roles.
Broad understanding of various industries and an aptitude for quickly learning new fields to provide guidance to a diverse client base.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of delivering clear, constructive feedback.
Experience with remote work tools and platforms (e.g., Discord, Gsuite, Asana), and managing teams across different time zones.
Availability to participate in in-person meetings with the core team 2-3 times a week.
Analytical mindset with a proactive approach to addressing challenges and improving team processes.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4b9e8c76-cad6-.title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4b9e8c76-cad6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in France. This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community. You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization. The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes. You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations. The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones. You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences. Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement. Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion. Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement. Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features. Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance. Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification. Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture. Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments. Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality. Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment. Requirements Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x , including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android. Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers. Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider , as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation. Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies. Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups. Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage. Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices. Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes. Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team. Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills. Benefits Fully remote, full-time working opportunity. Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins. 28

jobgether-jobgether:lever:980e594e-af11-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Sales Manager B2B based in Germany. This is a high-impact opportunity to help build a new B2B vertical within a fast-growing performance-driven business focused on the U.S. home services market. You’ll take ownership of developing a strong network of contractors and lead buyers, from prospecting through negotiation and contract closure. The role combines hands-on business development with the opportunity to build scalable sales processes and partnership systems from the ground up. You’ll use data and performance metrics to evaluate opportunities, optimize partner relationships, and drive measurable commercial results. Beyond sales, you’ll contribute to B2B brand building through targeted content, online initiatives, industry research, and potentially U.S. conferences. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy in a lean team where initiative, accountability, and measurable impact are highly valued. For strong senior contributors, the role also offers the opportunity to participate in a shares program and grow alongside the success of the new business vertical. Build and develop a high-quality network of contractors and lead buyers across the U.S. home services and home improvement markets. Independently identify and qualify prospective B2B partners through research, outbound prospecting, networking, and other lead-generation activities. Conduct discovery and demo calls with potential partners, manage negotiations, and drive qualified opportunities through to signed agreements. Develop and maintain long-term relationships with partners, ensuring consistent communication and strong commercial performance. Collect and analyze partner feedback on lead quality, appointment rates, close rates, and other relevant performance indicators. Use data and performance metrics to identify opportunities, improve partner outcomes, and inform commercial decisions. Contribute to the development of the B2B brand through targeted partner-facing content, online activities, and initiatives designed to generate new partnerships. Research the U.S. home services market, identify new opportunities, and continuously develop ideas for improving the sales and partnership strategy. Build and automate sales and partnership processes to create scalable systems rather than relying solely on manual execution. Plan and execute initiatives independently, from initial research and ideation through implementation, measurement, and optimization. Represent the business at relevant industry conferences and events in the U.S. when appropriate, with a focus on developing valuable commercial relationships. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align partnership acquisition, lead quality, commercial objectives, and overall business performance. Requirements: 2+ years of professional experience in B2B Sales, Business Development, or a closely related commercial role, with demonstrated experience prospecting and closing deals. 2+ years of experience in Home Services or Home Improvement, with a strong understanding of contractors, lead buyers, and the dynamics of lead-based business models. Demonstrated ability to independently generate leads, conduct sales conversations, negotiate, and close B2B partnerships. Practical experience automating sales or business processes, with the ability to build repeatable systems rather than simply execute individual tasks. Strong data-driven mindset and analytical skills, with the ability to make commercial decisions based on performance metrics and evidence. Proven track record of strong professional results, supported by specific measurable achievements and commercial outcomes. Highly structured approach to work, with the ability to maintain attention to detail while understanding the broader business picture. southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:b13eb63.title: Legal Engagement Manager
southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:b13eb63.description: ABOUT CENTARI At Centari, we're transforming the world's contracts into actionable intelligence. Every firm has the same AI now. What separates them is institutional intelligence: how the firm has structured deals, priced risk, and navigated markets across every transaction it has closed. It’s why a client picks one law firm over another, and why an LP backs one fund over the next. And today, this knowledge sits buried in closed deals and in the heads of the people who worked on them. Centari brings it to the surface as structured data that AI can act on, empowering companies to generate new revenue and see opportunities no one else can. The most demanding transactional practices in the world are already building on Centari, including deal teams at Ropes & Gray, DLA Piper, Willkie, Fried Frank, and Wilson Sonsini. We proved it in law. Finance and the enterprise face the same problem at even greater scale, and we're going after all of it. We raised an oversubscribed Series A from investors including Sentinel Global, GTMfund, South Park Commons, Jack Altman, RiverPark Capital, and Recall Capital, and now we're building the team to match our ambition. For more information, check out http://centari.com/centari.com http://centari.com or find us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/centariapp/. ABOUT THE ROLE We are hiring a Legal Engagement Manager on our Customer team, bridging Centari's AI technology and our AmLaw 100 client base by working directly with senior legal executives to define data requirements and expand value. You will lead the project management of Centari’s client-facing engagements, translating complex client needs into technical requirements, with the ability to build trusted advisor relationships with partners at the world's most prestigious firms. While you will collaborate closely with our technical teams to deliver solutions, your primary focus is as the face of Centari's implementation team to our enterprise clients, driving successful rollouts and building long-term partnerships. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Client delivery. Every active engagement runs on time, at quality, and with the client fully informed. When something slips, you see it first and fix it preemptively. - The operational infrastructure. The workflows, templates, and tracking systems that let our implementation team scale engagements without creating chaos. You build what doesn't exist and improve what does. - The health of the portfolio. On-time deliveries, client satisfaction, open requests, and escalations are your numbers. You own the answer when someone asks how a specific implementation project is going. - Client-to-team translation. You are the path between what a client needs and what our Applied Legal Research team builds. Requirements that reach the team from you are specific, prioritized, and actionable. - Business reviews. You prepare and run the reviews that show clients the value of what's been delivered, document ROI, and support conversations about what comes next. WHAT YOU BRING - You have run a complex, multi-stakeholder project end to end where the path wasn't clear at the start. Come with the specific example: what you inherited, what you decided, what it cost, what it produced. - 4+ years in project management, client engagement, or operations in enterprise software, professional services, or a similarly high-complexity service environment. - You have worked at an early-stage company where the processes you needed didn't exist yet.
